theorem.statement: For every nonempty Boolean CNF F of maximum clause width at most 3 with surplus sigma(F)<=2, there is a deterministic polynomial-time satisfiability-preserving transition that strictly decreases the syntactic measure n(F)+c(F).
theorem.scope: ONE STEP FROM A WIDTH<=3 STATE. The theorem does not claim that a Davis-Putnam successor remains width<=3, and therefore does not claim an iterated polynomial decider for all formulas initially having sigma<=2.

cases.transition: compute a nontrivial matching autarky and remove the clauses it satisfies
cases.basis: A nonempty clause-set is matching-lean iff sigma>=1; matching-autarky reduction / the matching-lean kernel is polynomial-time computable.
cases.progress: at least one clause is deleted, so n+c strictly decreases after simplification

cases.transition: apply the constructive width<=3 MLCR/autarky theorem proved in R44AO
cases.basis: R44AO constructively proves the Kullmann-Zhao critical-autarky witness step for Boolean clause-sets of maximum width <=3.
cases.progress: a nontrivial autarky deletes at least one clause; simplification cannot increase n, hence n+c strictly decreases

cases.transition: choose a fixed-tiebreak minimum-degree variable v and eliminate v exactly by Davis-Putnam
cases.progress: v disappears and clause count does not increase, so n+c decreases by at least one

cases.transition: choose a fixed-tiebreak minimum-degree variable v and eliminate v exactly by Davis-Putnam
cases.bound: for nonnegative p,q with p+q<=4, p*q<=4<=p+q when p+q=4, and directly p*q<=p+q for smaller sums
cases.progress: v disappears and clause count does not increase, so n+c decreases by at least one

non_mersenne_values.definition: nM(k) is the k-th positive integer that is not a Mersenne number 2^r-1

algorithmic_accounting.surplus_computation: polynomial-time by the cited autarky/deficiency framework
algorithmic_accounting.autarky_branch: polynomial by matching-autarky machinery for sigma<=0, or by R44AO for width<=3 when the surplus/min-degree trigger fires
algorithmic_accounting.DP_branch: one exact elimination with at most p*q resolvents; under the selected degree bounds the clause count is nonincreasing
algorithmic_accounting.determinism: fix lexicographic tie-breaking for all variable/set choices

frontier_effect.proved: No nonempty width<=3 state with sigma<=2 can be a fixed point of the union of these exact transition rules.
frontier_effect.not_proved: The successor of a DP step can contain width-4 clauses; R44BA therefore does not prove that repeated application stays in the R44BA hypothesis or decides all initial low-surplus 3CNFs in polynomial time.
frontier_effect.next_structural_layer: A width<=3 state that is simultaneously irreducible under the R44BA rules must have sigma>=3. At sigma=3, nM(3)=5 and the first nonexpanding-DP-unsafe minimum-degree profile is (3,2)/(2,3).
